music_description: Two singles, out now — a night drive through neon and static. Pick a track below.
about_p1: MINT SUIT builds soundscapes for the edge between memory and dream: warm synths, a future-funk groove, and a layer of lo-fi dust over everything — like a Polaroid of a city you never visited.
about_p2: It's a suit stitched from neon light and skyscraper windows — R&B, ambient, and synthwave sewn with the same thread: nostalgia, elegance, and a quiet melancholy calm.
bio_intro: Mint Suit is an independent electronic music project characterized by its atmospheric approach and attention to detail.

bio_points.label: Genre & Sound
bio_points.text: Primarily rooted in electronic music, blending atmospheric soundscapes, sample-based production, and meticulously crafted digital textures.

bio_points.label: Aesthetics & Identity
bio_points.text: Features a distinct visual and sonic direction with vaporwave and conceptual influences, tailored for independent distribution platforms such as Bandcamp.

bio_points.label: Production Approach
bio_points.text: Focuses on clean production, digital composition, audio design, and building immersive ambient environments rather than following conventional commercial formulas.
